scenarios.name: test-correct-copy
scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage MirrorworksTest#TestCorrectCopy.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[copy-token-own-etb-replacement-not-collected]: the Mirrorworks token copy of Mox Diamond enters without its own "If CARDNAME would enter, you may discard a land" replacement being offered (transcript: only one discard ask; 2 Mox on battlefield, 1 Mountain in graveyard). foldCopyToken mints the token via AddObject in an untracked ZLibrary state not in any zone list (engine/events/apply_copy.go:224-231, engine/state/game.go:757), effCopyPermanent then emits its battlefield MoveZone (engine/effects/copypermanent.go:840), and the replacement-source scan only visits zone lists Library..Stack + Command (engine/rules/repl_zoneskip.go:281,303), so the entering token's own R: line is never collected. CR 614.12, 707.2 (copy token has Mox Diamond's replacement ability as it would exist on the battlefield).
